Common Cold.symptoms: Runny nose, blocked nose, sneezing, sore throat and cough.

Cough.symptoms: Cough, throat irritation and sometimes mucus.

Flu (Influenza).symptoms: Fever, chills, body aches, fatigue, cough and headache.

Sore Throat.symptoms: Throat pain, irritation and pain while swallowing.

Allergic Rhinitis.symptoms: Sneezing, runny nose, nasal itching and watery eyes.

Sinusitis.symptoms: Blocked nose, facial pressure, headache and nasal discharge.

Asthma.symptoms: Wheezing, coughing, chest tightness and shortness of breath.

Bronchitis.symptoms: Cough, mucus, fatigue and chest discomfort.

Acidity / Heartburn.symptoms: Burning chest sensation, acid taste and indigestion.

Indigestion.symptoms: Fullness, bloating, belching and upper abdominal discomfort.

Gas / Flatulence.symptoms: Bloating, abdominal discomfort and passing gas.

Constipation.symptoms: Hard stools, infrequent bowel movements and straining.

Diarrhea.symptoms: Loose stools, frequent bowel movements and abdominal cramps.

Nausea.symptoms: Feeling sick, queasiness and reduced appetite.

Gastritis.symptoms: Upper abdominal discomfort, nausea and indigestion.

Food Poisoning.symptoms: Diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal cramps and sometimes fever.

Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS).symptoms: Abdominal pain, bloating, diarrhea or constipation.

Headache.symptoms: Head pain, pressure and sometimes light sensitivity.

Migraine.symptoms: Moderate/severe headache, nausea and light or sound sensitivity.

Toothache.symptoms: Tooth pain, sensitivity and pain while chewing.

Back Pain.symptoms: Back pain, stiffness and reduced movement.

Neck Pain.symptoms: Neck pain, stiffness and reduced movement.

Joint Pain.symptoms: Joint pain, stiffness and possible swelling.

Menstrual Cramps.symptoms: Lower abdominal cramps, back pain and fatigue.

Sprain.symptoms: Pain, swelling, bruising and difficulty moving the joint.

Muscle Strain.symptoms: Muscle pain, tenderness and reduced movement.

Acne.symptoms: Pimples, blackheads, whiteheads and inflamed spots.

Fungal Skin Infection.symptoms: Itching, scaling, redness and fungal rash.

Ringworm.symptoms: Circular scaly rash, redness and itching.

Skin Rash.symptoms: Redness, itching and changes in skin appearance.

Sunburn.symptoms: Redness, pain, warmth and possible blistering.

Psoriasis.symptoms: Red, scaly skin patches and itching.

Urinary Tract Infection (UTI).symptoms: Burning urination, frequent urination, urgency and lower abdominal discomfort.
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI).note: Typically requires prescription antibiotics; consult a doctor.

Conjunctivitis (Pink Eye).symptoms: Red eye, discharge, irritation and watering.

Ear Infection.symptoms: Ear pain, reduced hearing and sometimes fever.

Throat Infection.symptoms: Sore throat, painful swallowing and sometimes fever.

Skin Infection.symptoms: Redness, swelling, pain and possible discharge.
Skin Infection.note: Treatment depends on cause (bacterial/fungal/viral); consult a doctor for diagnosis.

Tonsillitis.symptoms: Sore throat, swollen tonsils, fever and difficulty swallowing.

Diabetes.symptoms: Increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue and possible blurred vision.
Diabetes.note: Requires medical diagnosis and prescription management; consult a doctor.

High Blood Pressure (Hypertension).symptoms: Often no symptoms; headaches or dizziness may occur.
High Blood Pressure (Hypertension).note: Requires medical diagnosis and prescription management; consult a doctor.

High Cholesterol.note: Requires medical diagnosis and prescription management; consult a doctor.

Thyroid Disorders.symptoms: Fatigue, weight changes, temperature sensitivity and heart-rate changes.
Thyroid Disorders.note: Requires medical diagnosis and prescription management; consult a doctor.

Anemia.symptoms: Fatigue, weakness, pale skin and shortness of breath.

Obesity.symptoms: Excess body weight and possible reduced physical fitness.
Obesity.note: Managed through lifestyle changes and medical guidance rather than OTC medicine.

Vitamin D Deficiency.symptoms: May have no symptoms; muscle or bone problems can occur.

Vitamin B12 Deficiency.symptoms: Fatigue, weakness and possible numbness or tingling.

Menstrual Pain.symptoms: Cramps, lower abdominal pain and back pain.

Irregular Periods.note: Underlying cause needs medical evaluation; treatment is typically prescription-based.

Premenstrual Syndrome (PMS).symptoms: Mood changes, bloating, breast tenderness and cramps.

Menopause Symptoms.symptoms: Hot flashes, sleep problems and mood changes.
Menopause Symptoms.note: Treatment options (e.g., hormone therapy) require medical guidance.

Fever.symptoms: Raised temperature, chills, fatigue and body aches.

Fatigue.symptoms: Low energy, tiredness and reduced concentration.

Dizziness.note: Many possible causes; persistent or severe dizziness needs medical evaluation.

Dehydration.symptoms: Thirst, dry mouth, reduced urination and weakness.

Insomnia.symptoms: Difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep or daytime tiredness.

Anxiety.symptoms: Excessive worry, restlessness, tension and difficulty concentrating.
Anxiety.note: Best addressed with professional evaluation; not typically treated with OTC medicine.

Motion Sickness.symptoms: Nausea, dizziness and vomiting during travel.

Allergies.symptoms: Sneezing, itching, runny nose and watery eyes.

Hemorrhoids (Piles).symptoms: Rectal discomfort, itching and bleeding during bowel movements.
